title: OpenChem structure template candidates
notes: Not loaded by the application. Do not add to _SHIPPED_FILES.
chebi_id is an exact InChIKey match to a ChEBI default structure only.
editor_eligible is not an editor smoke test.

categories.title: Generic
categories.description: Common starter molecules useful on an empty canvas.

categories.title: Rings
categories.description: Common ring systems as complete molecules.

categories.title: Cyclopentyl rings
categories.description: Cyclopentane, cyclopentene, cyclopentadiene, and methylcyclopentane as complete molecules, not five-membered heterocycles.

categories.title: Phenyl rings
categories.description: Benzene and phenyl-containing complete molecules. Attachment-fragment use is deferred.

categories.title: Amino acids
categories.description: Free proteinogenic amino acids plus selenocysteine and ornithine (neutral carboxylic acid + amine). Protected derivatives are not in this category.

categories.title: Aromatics
categories.description: Representative aromatic molecules and scaffolds.

categories.title: Bicyclics
categories.description: Recognizable bicyclic parent structures.

categories.title: Bridged polycyclics
categories.description: Bridged and cage-like polycycles.

categories.title: Crown ethers
categories.description: Common crown ethers and selected derivatives.

categories.title: Cycloalkanes
categories.description: Saturated monocycles C3–C12 inclusive, plus methylcyclopentane and methylcyclohexane. Bicyclic decalins are not in this category.

categories.title: Conformers
categories.description: Conformational templates need 3D coordinates; V1 molblock_for regenerates 2D.

categories.title: Heterocycles
categories.description: Representative heterocyclic complete molecules.

categories.title: Polycyclics
categories.description: Fused and cage polycycles.

categories.title: Homology groups
categories.description: Query/variable-group concept. Not ordinary SMILES. Not populated.

categories.title: Alpha D sugars
categories.description: Named alpha-D sugars with ring form and anomer recorded.

categories.title: Beta D sugars
categories.description: Named beta-D sugars with ring form and anomer recorded.

categories.title: Deoxynucleosides
categories.description: Named 2'-deoxyribonucleosides.

categories.title: Flavonoids
categories.description: Named flavonoid aglycones and subclass parents.

categories.title: Nucleobases
categories.description: Free nucleobases (A, G, C, T, U, hypoxanthine). Not methylxanthine alkaloids.

categories.title: Nucleosides
categories.description: Named ribonucleosides only (not deoxynucleosides or nucleotides).

categories.title: Organometallics
categories.description: Selected compounds with metal-carbon bonds. Not editor-eligible until coordination display is tested.

categories.title: Peptide building blocks
categories.description: Free amino acids and complete N-protected amino acids (Fmoc/Boc). No sequence builder.

categories.title: Protoalkaloids
categories.description: Amino-acid-derived amines whose nitrogen is not in a heterocycle, where the assignment is not disputed.

categories.title: True alkaloids
categories.description: Amino-acid-derived alkaloids with nitrogen in a heterocycle.

categories.title: Pseudoalkaloids
categories.description: Nitrogenous metabolites whose nitrogen is not introduced as part of an amino-acid skeleton (Aniszewski 2015). Compound-level assignments may be unresolved.

categories.title: Vitamins
categories.description: Named vitamers, not family names.

categories.title: My Templates
categories.description: Existing user store. Not a shipped category.

categories.title: Solvents and reagents
categories.description: Common laboratory solvents and simple reagents.

categories.title: Functional-group examples
categories.description: Small complete molecules illustrating common functional groups.

categories.title: Terpenoids and steroids
categories.description: A few recognizable terpenes and steroids.

categories.title: Cofactors and metabolites
categories.description: A few named cofactors, including nucleotides such as ATP.

categories.title: Coordination complexes
categories.description: Metal complexes without requiring a metal-carbon bond. Not editor-eligible until coordination display is tested.
